limitations: Only eight calls were measured; percentile estimates are descriptive, not stable tail-latency estimates.
Latency is API end-to-end proposal generation latency, not first effective physical action latency.
The pilot did not execute a coordinator, simulator, device action, state feedback, or task completion loop.
All calls used non-thinking mode; model-quality comparisons have not yet been run.
The CareAgent received the initial state rather than the scheduled exogenous occupancy update, so its noop response tests protocol behavior rather than the final HC-SEED-004 scenario.
audit_note: An earlier run appeared to pass 8/8 under a shallow validator, but manual review found one nested field named value instead of value_json. After adding recursive field validation, this fresh run passed 8/8. The earlier run is excluded from these aggregate metrics.
